estimator: Equal base means of matched world/arm cells. Whole-base percentile bootstrap stratified by numeric/identity/dependency crossed with decision change; 10000 replicates, seed 20271015. Direct differences of effects; no significance-by-condition inference.
independent_unit: base pair; retain both worlds and all arms in every resampled cluster
influential_pair_hypothesis: The pilot's objective-target benefit partly reflects preservation of numerical objective values through summaries; expect a smaller repetition effect under lossless root transport. This is the sole feature hypothesis from that pair, tested by the already frozen root transport interaction; fresh objective confirmation supplies complementary replication, not a mediated-effect estimate.
limitations: Uniformly repeating objectives adds nine reports versus three for selective repetition, so balance and total length/dose differ. Target selection uses candidate-name rank balanced across bases, not the correct answer. No flat arm: hierarchy interaction is tested by the unchanged original study. No new claim about causal mediation. Repeated reports share their original source/execution ancestry.
missingness: Incomplete model runs are reported as incomplete, not confirmatory. Analyze a model only after all 24 clusters and all frozen arms finish. No cross-model pooling of partial data. Budget/execution stops are independent of accuracy.
model_rule: Report Phi-4 and Qwen3 separately; no pooled headline. Same 24 bases and one stochastic repetition per cell for each model.
precision: 24 clusters, four per full stratum, 12 per change category. Planning uses validation variance, not sign or significance. Intervals may be wide; no power claim. No effect-dependent sample extension.
primary_outcome: Exact world decision correctness; completed malformed/truncated outputs remain errors.
reporting: Every two-arm table includes absolute accuracies, base counts, trajectory/physical/logical call counts, paired effect, interval, corrections/regressions/unchanged, base effects and descriptive leave-one-base-out range. Three-arm/four-arm differences report component means and do not invent a binary correction count.
secondary_outcomes: both worlds correct, separate consequential and harmless strata
Brier and log loss with valid-probability denominators
tokens and allocated inference time per correct decision
